title_zh: 不把柱形图差距当成统计结论

scenario.label_zh: 不等样本图表的结论边界
scenario.goal_zh: 说明图表与样本差异、约定修改标题和样本量标注并提出把底层数据带给教师的建议

context_zh: 研究方法课中，成人学员 Sofia 与 Ken 检查两组虚构练习成绩的图表。
author: author-phase12-b

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: There’s a stark contrast between these bars. The blue group’s average is substantially higher.

sentences.speaker: Ken
sentences.text: Have we done any statistical analysis, or are we just looking at the picture?

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: Just the picture. Also, the blue group has eight people and the red group has eighty.

sentences.speaker: Ken
sentences.text: Then the headline “the new method works” goes beyond what we’ve checked.

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: I’ll remove that headline and list the sample sizes beside the bars.

sentences.speaker: Ken
sentences.text: Good. Let’s take the underlying data to our tutor before drawing a statistical conclusion.
